context.purpose: Assemble excerpts of PCM16 recordings with frame-accurate cuts, gains and nonoverlapping linear fades.
context.assumptions: Absolute canonical PCM16 little-endian WAV files, mono/stereo and identical sample rates/channels; latest stable SoX 14.4.2.
context.constraints: Eight clips, 262144 total output frames, 4MiB total source bytes, 1048576 combined scalar samples. No clipping, resampling, mix, crossfade or authored effects.
context.inspection: Reopen native audio.wav and per-clip WAVs; standard-library wave/struct and analytic frame envelopes independently check every sample. Summary is host inspection.
context.recovery: INVALID_AUDIO_FADE: shorten fades. AUDIO_SOURCE_BOUNDS: choose a trim inside source frames. AUDIO_CLIPPING: lower gain before fades. AUDIO_FORMAT_MISMATCH: supply equal rate/channels. INTERPRETER_NOT_FOUND: configure SoX 14.4.2.

workflow.scope: Isolated audio jobs support source-byte reuse invalidation and verified WAV artifacts.

composition.scope: Shared document references and finite parameter studies resolve before native audio editing.

lifecycle.timeout: One total deadline includes capture, version, every clip, concatenation and verification; CPU 30s, address space 512MiB, file 8MiB per native process.
lifecycle.cancellation: Shared tracked process-group cancellation terminates owned native jobs; cancellation is checked before publication.
lifecycle.logs: Authored/effective plans, WAV captures, input hashes, trusted launchers, submissions/stdout/stderr, per-clip WAVs and final audio retained.
lifecycle.verification: Strict RIFF and wave/struct reopening, analytic trim/gain/fade samples within 0.5001 PCM16 LSB (one quantisation plus sub-LSB PCM32 effects), exact integer concatenation, exact command/input/evidence/publication binding.

losses: Metadata retention/stripping is outside the verified contract; no resampling, channel conversion or compressed audio.
data.scope: Captured canonical RIFF PCM16, common rate/channels and bounded bytes/sample counts.

inspection.scope: Inspect audio-summary.json and retained frame edit decisions.
inspection.limits: No playback or interactive native session; use external audio tools for listening.
